visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands is shown in a close-up, holding a tangled mass of white and black charging cables and wired earphones against a plain white background. The fingers gently pull and poke at the knot. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a young man with brown hair and a black pleated blazer. He stands in front of a dark studio background featuring a blackboard with scientific sketches. He uses moderate hand gestures while speaking. (3) Overlaid graphics appear, including a split screen showing a transparent box being mechanically shaken to tangle cables inside. Scientific diagrams of mathematical knots with numbered points are displayed alongside the host. (4) A small, silver, cube-like robot device called Zen.V Bot is introduced on a light wood tabletop. It has a digital screen for a face and articulated arms. The host is seen interacting with its touch screen. (5) Promotional materials appear, showing official Qi2.2 certification documents. A person places an iPhone and an Apple Watch onto the robot's magnetic arms for charging. (6) A screen capture of a crowdfunding website (ZecZec) is shown, displaying progress bars, pricing, and campaign details for the robot device. (7) The host returns to the screen, resting his chin on his hands beside the robot device, smiling slightly at the camera before the final social media call-to-action overlays appear.
